```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)  # Example for SQLite - change as needed
con <- dbConnect(RSQLite::SQLite(), "./../competition.db")  # Replace with your database file
table_names <- dbListTables(con)
data <- dbReadTable(con, "submissions")  # Replace with your table name
```

```{r}

df <- data |>
  mutate(
    age_group = case_when(
      age <= 18 ~ "18-",
      between(age, 19, 40) ~ "19-40",
      age > 40 ~ "40+"
    )
  ) |>
  group_by(age_group, sex) |>
  arrange(desc(total_score)) |>
  mutate(rank = row_number()) |>
  ungroup()



ttt <- df |>
  select(id, boulders_climbed)

```
